extensionDescription.message: An extension for jut.su that allows videos to play automatically, skip anime intros, and automatically start the next episode.

extension_description.message: An extension for jut.su that enables video autoplay, skipping anime intros, and auto-starting the next episode.

mark_video_timeline.message: Mark intro and credits on timeline

next_series_before_end_description.message: Automatically start the next episode before credits begin.

next_series_after_end_description.message: Automatically start the next episode after credits end.

skip_intro_description.message: Automatically skip anime intros to save time.

video_from_start_description.message: Always start the video from the beginning, ignoring previous progress.

click_to_fullscreen_description.message: An overlay with two zones is created: "Fullscreen" and "Exit". Click "Fullscreen" to enter fullscreen mode or "Exit" to close the overlay. This feature was primarily designed for mobile devices, where you first need to tap the player and then a button to activate fullscreen.

add_speed_control_description.message: Add a panel to adjust video playback speed.

mark_video_timeline_description.message: Show markers for intro and credits on the timeline: Yellow marker — for the opening. Red marker — for the start of credits. This data is taken directly from the player, but sometimes markers may be missing.

pseudo_fullscreen_description.message: Enable Pseudo-fullscreen mode. In this mode, you retain access to the player, and in Chrome, the cursor automatically hides if the mouse isn’t moved for a while. A button to toggle this mode also appears in the player. This feature primarily creates this button, allowing you to switch modes. 💡 Quick toggle: press "T" on the keyboard. Toggling doesn’t fully disable the feature but changes its state — the button remains available even if pseudo-fullscreen is off. Additionally: If you activate the browser’s fullscreen mode (F11), pseudo-fullscreen acts as normal and stays enabled even after moving to the next episode.

page_description.message: This page provides information about all extension features, allowing you to modify them, along with a list of available shortcuts.

settings_description.message: Here’s a description of how various extension features work.

shortcuts_description.message: Here are the shortcuts and their functions.

shortcut_numbers_desc.message: Rewind the video to the corresponding percentage of its duration.

shortcut_t_desc.message: Toggle Pseudo-fullscreen mode. (Works only when the "Pseudo-fullscreen mode" feature is enabled.)
